transcript.text: Thanks for calling Summit Air, you've reached our automated assistant. How can I help?
Hi, my carbon monoxide detector keeps going off, and I have a mild headache. I'm in Yonkers, NY 10701.

Carbon monoxide is dangerous, so please get everyone out into fresh air right now, and leave the door open behind you. Once you're outside, call nine-one-one, especially if anyone has a headache, dizziness or nausea. Don't go back in until the fire department says it's safe.
Okay, I’m stepping outside now and will call 911. Thank you. Goodbye.
Please stay outside and call nine-one-one right away if you haven't already.
I've called 911 and waiting outside now. Thanks again. Goodbye.
You're doing the right thing by staying outside and waiting for help.
Please stay outside and call nine-one-one immediately if you have not done so. Goodbye.

tone.name: tone
tone.detail: The agent repeatedly reminded the caller to call 911 and stay outside after the caller had already confirmed taking those actions, failing to avoid repetition.
